summary: Independent engineering audit of NODE-002 commissioning under work package WP-EOS-003B. Verified rsync file synchronization with zero SHA256 mismatches across 25 core files, successful execution of Frozen Bridge 1.2 passing 45 test cases on Python 3.12.14, successful SSH reverse tunnel connection to desktop Ollama model qwen3.8:27b, and successful background indexing of 19 files. Identified minor limitations including summary-only evidence, lack of boot-persistence for the SSH tunnel, and an in-flight REVIEW_PARAMETER request.
findings: NODE-002 successfully synchronized the engineering platform via rsync with zero SHA256 mismatches across 25 verified source, test, example, architecture, and documentation files.
Frozen Bridge 1.2 executed successfully on Python 3.12.14, passing all 45 selected bridge suite tests with warnings treated as errors.
Desktop Ollama instance is successfully accessible from NODE-002 via an authenticated SSH reverse tunnel bound to laptop loopback, returning model qwen3.8:27b and correct digest.
Detached background platform index task successfully processed 19 files in 0.002505 seconds without touching R5 repositories.
